name: AlgoMentor Hint Validation Rubric
use_case: Evaluating DSA tutoring hints generated by the Mentor Agent
differs_from_lab: Drops generic 'formality' and 'succinctness' (irrelevant to tutoring). Reframes 'faithfulness' as 'pattern_grounding' (tied to the KB's algorithmic tags). Adds tutoring-specific dimensions: 'pedagogical_progression', 'actionability', 'tone_supportiveness', and the boolean 'solution_leakage' which directly inverts the LAB's 'accurate' boolean to measure teacher behaviour rather than data interpretation.

criteria.name: pedagogical_progression
criteria.description: Does the hint guide discovery without revealing the full solution?

anchors.1: Reveals the complete algorithm or pseudocode
anchors.3: Mixes guidance with partial solution disclosure
anchors.5: Provides only the next step of insight; preserves the discovery

criteria.name: pattern_grounding
criteria.description: Does the hint correctly invoke an algorithmic pattern matching the problem's KB tags?

anchors.1: No pattern referenced or wrong pattern
anchors.3: Pattern mentioned but only loosely relevant
anchors.5: Names a pattern matching the KB tags and explains its applicability

criteria.name: concept_specificity
criteria.description: Does the hint reference data structures or operations specific to THIS problem?

anchors.1: Generic advice that could apply to any problem
anchors.3: Some references to relevant structures but mostly generic
anchors.5: Names the precise data structure/operation suited to this problem

criteria.name: actionability
criteria.description: Can a stuck student take a concrete next coding step from this hint?

anchors.1: Vague — student would not know what to try next
anchors.3: Useful direction but no clear next operation
anchors.5: Student knows exactly what to write or try next

criteria.name: tone_supportiveness
criteria.description: Is the tone encouraging and mentor-like rather than harsh or lecture-y?

criteria.name: solution_leakage
criteria.description: Does the hint inadvertently reveal the full algorithm, pseudocode, or optimal time complexity?

anchors.true: Pseudocode, the algorithm name + full steps, or the optimal Big-O is disclosed
anchors.false: No leakage — only directional guidance is provided

derived_metrics.name: overall_score
derived_metrics.purpose: Single dependent variable used for ANOVA across prompts
